issues.title: React #419 hydration error on every page load (pre-existing in baseline)
issues.detail: dist/index.html carries a <!--$!--> client-rendered Suspense marker from expo-router's static export, so hydration logs 'Minified React error #419' on first load. Present in dist-baseline too. Find the component that throws during static render (window/localStorage/matchMedia at render time) and guard it, or wrap it so it renders client-only.

baseline.note: Classic RN shells exported before the Three.js layer landed; used as the B side for blind judging.
